kaikki_vikisozluk.u: عين الرضا عن كل عيب كليلة
kaikki_vikisozluk.e: عَيْنُ الرِضَا عَن كُلِّ عَيْبٍ كَلِيلةٌ • (ʕaynu r-riḍā ʕan kulli ʕaybin kalīlatun)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, “the eye of fondness is weak-sighted for any blemish.”
s: “the eye of fondness is weak-sighted for any blemish.”
Literally, “the eye of fondness is weak-sighted for any blemish.”
g: People tend not to notice, or to ignore, the faults of those whom they like and favour.
r: ʕaynu r-riḍā ʕan kulli ʕaybin kalīlatun
